title: Video Door Phone vs Intercom: Which Should You Install?
excerpt: Complete guide comparing video door phones (VDP) with traditional intercoms. Costs, features, security benefits, and which works best for apartments and houses.
author: Eye Smart Security Systems

faqs.q: Can I use video door phone without WiFi?
faqs.a: Yes. VDP with wired cable works without internet. WiFi/cloud features only require internet if you want remote viewing. Wired VDP systems work perfectly in power + cable network.

faqs.q: Is video door phone more secure than intercom?
faqs.a: Yes, because you SEE who's at the door before opening. Intercoms only provide voice. With VDP, you get facial recognition to identify threats or verify delivery persons.
Intercom: ₹8,000-15,000. Video door phone: ₹12,000-25,000 (wired) or ₹18,000-35,000 (WiFi). The extra cost is justified by added security.

faqs.q: Can I have both intercom and VDP?
faqs.a: Yes, many large homes do. Use VDP at main entrance (most critical) and intercom for internal office-to-office communication. Cost: ₹25,000-40,000 combined.

faqs.q: Do video door phones work in poor internet?
faqs.a: Wired VDP always works (internet not required). WiFi models need stable 1-2 Mbps. If internet is unreliable, choose wired VDP. Both have video recording without internet.

Video Door Phone vs Intercom: Which is Right for You?

When it comes to entrance communication and security in Delhi NCR homes and offices, most people choose between video door phone (VDP) and traditional intercom.

Both have advantages. This guide helps you decide based on security needs, budget, and property type.

Technology Overview

Video Door Phone (VDP)

A camera + speaker unit installed at the entrance. When someone rings the bell, you see live video + hear audio on your door unit (or mobile phone). You can speak back and control the door lock remotely.

  • Types: Wired (via coaxial cable) or WiFi
  • Resolution: Usually 2MP (1080p)
  • Night Vision: IR or thermal (see in darkness)
  • Features: Video recording, face detection, motion alerts

Intercom System

Traditional audio-only communication between entrance and home/office. Visitor presses bell, buzzer rings inside, you press intercom button to talk.

  • Types: Analog (simple wiring) or IP-based (digital)
  • Communication: Voice only (no video)
  • Range: Works within 100-200 meters
  • Features: Talk, listen, call multiple units

Security Comparison

VDP Security Advantages

  • ✅ Visual Identification: See who's at door before opening (prevents forced entry)
  • ✅ Face Recording: Video proof of who visited (for theft/burglary investigation)
  • ✅ Motion Detection: Alerts you if someone loiters at door
  • ✅ Night Vision: Identify people even at night
  • ✅ Verification: Confirm delivery person, guest legitimacy
  • ✅ Remote Access: See door even when away from home

Intercom Security Advantages

  • ✅ Voice Recognition: You know the voice of people you expect
  • ✅ No Video Privacy Concern: Audio-only is less intrusive
  • ⚠️ Limited ID: Intruders can lie about identity

Security Verdict

VDP is significantly more secure. You can't be tricked by voice alone. A video door phone has prevented countless robberies and forced entries in Delhi NCR.

Which Is Best for Your Situation?

Choose Intercom If:

  • Budget is very tight (<₹15,000)
  • You need internal office communication (multiple departments)
  • Internet is unreliable
  • Your society has existing intercom infrastructure
  • You prefer audio-only for privacy reasons
  • Example: Small office building, staff intercommunication needed

Choose Video Door Phone (Wired) If:

  • Security is your priority
  • Budget allows ₹18,000-25,000
  • You want wired reliability (no WiFi dependency)
  • You want video recording without internet/cloud costs
  • Example: Home, independent house, office entrance

Choose Video Door Phone (WiFi) If:

  • You want remote access (view door from mobile, anywhere)
  • You have stable WiFi
  • Budget allows ₹22,000-35,000
  • You want smart home integration
  • You travel frequently and want to monitor remotely
  • Example: Working professional, family home with remote monitoring

Specific Use Cases

Apartment in Gated Society

  • Recommendation: WiFi VDP (budget: ₹20,000-28,000)
  • Reason: Security cabling difficult in shared buildings. WiFi works well in apartments. Mobile alerts useful when you're at office.

Independent House in Noida/Ghaziabad

  • Recommendation: Wired VDP + local recording (budget: ₹18,000-24,000)
  • Reason: Don't want internet dependency. Wired is more reliable. Local recording works even if WiFi fails.

Corporate Office (20-50 employees)

  • Recommendation: VDP at main entrance + Intercom for internal
  • Cost: VDP ₹15,000 + Intercom System ₹50,000 = ₹65,000
  • Reason: VDP for security at entrance, intercom for inter-department calls

Retail Shop/Showroom

  • Recommendation: WiFi VDP (budget: ₹20,000-30,000)
  • Reason: Remote monitoring while traveling. Records all customer/delivery person visits. Prevents shoplifting.

Hybrid Setup: Best Practice

Many successful Delhi NCR businesses combine both technologies:

Recommended Configuration

  • Main Entrance: WiFi Video Door Phone (₹22,000)
  • Back Entrance: Wired VDP (₹18,000)
  • Internal Communication: Intercom System (₹40,000 for 5 units)
  • Total Cost: ₹80,000

Benefits

  • All entry points covered with video
  • Internal staff can communicate without shouting
  • Mobile alerts for both entrances
  • Comprehensive security and convenience

Popular Brands

  • Wired VDP: CP Plus, Hikvision DS-KV6113-WPE (₹12,000-18,000)
  • WiFi VDP: Realme Video Doorbell, Hikvision ezviz (₹15,000-28,000)
  • Intercom: Turck intercom systems, BPT systems (₹40,000-80,000 per building)

Browse our door phone and intercom products

Installation Complexity

Intercom

  • Requires running cables (coaxial or twisted pair) to each unit
  • More complex for multi-story buildings
  • Professional installation recommended: 3-5 days

VDP (Wired)

  • Requires video cable + power cable to entrance
  • Simpler than intercom (fewer endpoints)
  • Professional installation recommended: 1-2 days

VDP (WiFi)

  • Only needs power at entrance (no cable needed!)
  • Easiest to install: self-installation possible in 30 minutes
  • Professional installation: 1-2 hours

Our Recommendation

For 90% of Delhi NCR homes and offices: WiFi Video Door Phone is the best choice.

  • ✅ Better security than intercom
  • ✅ More convenient than wired VDP
  • ✅ Remote monitoring (peace of mind)
  • ✅ Affordable at ₹20,000-28,000
  • ✅ No cable installation hassles

Exceptions:

  • Large office buildings → Intercom for internal communication
  • No WiFi available → Wired VDP
  • Extremely budget-conscious → Intercom

Conclusion

Video door phones are a significant upgrade over traditional intercoms in terms of security and convenience. For most Delhi NCR properties, the added security and remote monitoring justify the modest extra cost.
